## Flagship writing (information gain)

- [AI Isn't a Feature. It's a Workflow Problem.](https://winzenburg.com/articles/ai-isnt-a-feature-workflow): Core thesis: durable AI advantage comes from workflow redesign, not feature bolt-ons.
- [Why Most Design Systems Fail (And How to Fix Them)](https://winzenburg.com/articles/design-systems-fail): Organizational failure modes of design systems and AI-powered fixes from firsthand enterprise work.
- [The Agent Layer Is Becoming the Business Layer](https://winzenburg.com/articles/the-agent-layer-is-becoming-the-business-layer): Agent design as org design — ownership, authority, and operating boundaries.
- [How I Built an Enterprise Design System in 4 Weeks (Not 12 Months)](https://winzenburg.com/articles/design-system-4-weeks): First-person build story with concrete delivery outcomes.
- [The AI-Powered Design Tech Stack](https://winzenburg.com/articles/ai-tech-stack): Practitioner stack for AI-augmented design operations.
